name: Learning Activity
query:
SELECT
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.name AS "Candidate ID:Data:140",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.title AS "Title:Data:200",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.candidate_type AS "Type:Data:100",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.source_type AS "Source:Data:120",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.user AS "Teaching User:Link/User:120",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.status AS "Status:Data:90",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.testing_status AS "Testing Status:Data:100",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.confidence AS "Confidence:%%:70",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.conflict_count AS "Conflicts:Int:70",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.target_scope AS "Scope:Data:80",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.target_scope_value AS "Scope Value:Data:120",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.creation AS "Created:Datetime:150",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.approved_on AS "Approved On:Datetime:150",
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.approved_by AS "Approved By:Link/User:120"
FROM
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`
ORDER BY
    `tabAI Knowledge Candidate`.creation DESC
LIMIT 500
